analyst: This strategy trades a volume-profile breakout during the overnight 18:00–08:00 ET session, entering when price closes beyond the Point of Control band built from a 120-bar lookback and the net delta at that POC exceeds a 10 % imbalance threshold in the breakout direction. A 50-period EMA slope check (compared five bars back) acts as a trend filter, and three consecutive confirmation candles in the breakout direction are required before the order is placed, with a ten-bar cooldown between signals. The stop is set 250 dollars below entry for longs or above entry for shorts, and the take-profit target is 500 dollars. An optional breakeven stop can move the stop to entry plus one tick once unrealized profit reaches 150 dollars, and an optional trailing stop tightens the stop in 500-dollar increments after 1,000 dollars of profit. All open positions are force-closed the moment the session ends.
